description: This file defines the PHP class Chart_outcome_by_month which generates and renders a chart representing monthly outcomes based on Opportunities data in SuiteCRM. It handles user preferences for date ranges and users, fetches relevant data from the database, constructs XML data for the chart, and manages caching of generated charts.

classes.name: Chart_outcome_by_month
classes.description: A class responsible for generating a monthly outcome bar chart for Opportunities, including data retrieval, XML generation, caching, and chart rendering.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Handles user input, fetches data, and produces the chart display including the HTML and JavaScript necessary for rendering.

methods.name: gen_xml
methods.description: Generates the XML data for the chart based on query results, possibly using cached data if available, and returns the chart rendering.

methods.name: constructQuery
methods.description: Builds and returns the SQL query string used to retrieve opportunity data for the specified date range and user filters.

methods.name: constructGroupBy
methods.description: Returns the group by clauses for queries.
